final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), regional AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg FROM district_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, region_avg FROM regional WHERE account_count > region_avg) SELECT district_id, region, account_count, account_count - region_avg AS above_region_average, 1.0 * account_count / AVG(account_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_above_average_mean FROM above_avg ORDER BY ratio_to_above_average_mean DESC LIMIT 10
